+package info
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"net/http"
+)
+
+// Version is the version of the running Flipt binary, set at startup.
+var Version = "dev"
+
+// Flipt describes the running binary for the /meta/info endpoint.
+type Flipt struct {
+	Version         string `json:"version,omitempty"`
+	LatestVersion   string `json:"latestVersion,omitempty"`
+	Commit          string `json:"commit,omitempty"`
+	BuildDate       string `json:"buildDate,omitempty"`
+	GoVersion       string `json:"goVersion,omitempty"`
+	UpdateAvailable bool   `json:"updateAvailable"`
+	IsRelease       bool   `json:"isRelease"`
+}
+
+// ServeHTTP writes the Flipt metadata as JSON.
+func (f Flipt) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	out, err := json.Marshal(f)
+	if err != nil {
+		http.Error(w, "unable to serialize Flipt info", http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}
+
+	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+	if _, err := w.Write(out); err != nil {
+		// Headers may already have been written by the ResponseWriter.
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
+	}
+}

index 0000000..7b53785
--- /dev/null
+++ b/telemetry/telemetry.go
@@ -0,0 +1,210 @@
+// Package telemetry sends an anonymous, periodic usage ping.
+package telemetry
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"net/http"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sync"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gofrs/uuid"
+	"github.com/markphelps/flipt/config"
+	"github.com/markphelps/flipt/internal/info"
+	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
+)
+
+const (
+	schemaVersion = "1.0"
+	interval      = 4 * time.Hour
+	endpoint      = "https://telemetry.flipt.io/v1/track"
+)
+
+type state struct {
+	Version       string `json:"version"`
+	UUID          string `json:"uuid"`
+	LastTimestamp string `json:"lastTimestamp"`
+}
+
+// Reporter persists the anonymous host identifier and reports usage.
+type Reporter struct {
+	mu       sync.Mutex
+	state    state
+	path     string
+	client   *http.Client
+	endpoint string
+	logger   logrus.FieldLogger
+}
+
+// NewReporter creates a reporter when telemetry is enabled. A nil reporter
+// means telemetry was explicitly disabled. The caller should log any error
+// and continue serving requests.
+func NewReporter(cfg *config.Config, logger logrus.FieldLogger) (*Reporter, error) {
+	if !cfg.Meta.TelemetryEnabled {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+
+	dir := cfg.Meta.StateDirectory
+	if dir == "" {
+		base, err := os.UserConfigDir()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("finding telemetry state directory: %w", err)
+		}
+		dir = base
+	}
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("creating telemetry state directory: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	r := &Reporter{
+		path:     filepath.Join(dir, "telemetry.json"),
+		client:   &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second},
+		endpoint: endpoint,
+		logger:   logger,
+	}
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(r.path)
+	needsSave := false
+	switch {
+	case os.IsNotExist(err):
+		needsSave = true
+	case err != nil:
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading telemetry state: %w", err)
+	case json.Unmarshal(data, &r.state) != nil:
+		logger.Warn("invalid telemetry state; generating a new identifier")
+		r.state = state{}
+		needsSave = true
+	}
+
+	parsed, err := uuid.FromString(r.state.UUID)
+	if err != nil || parsed == uuid.Nil || parsed.Version() != 4 {
+		id, err := uuid.NewV4()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("generating telemetry identifier: %w", err)
+		}
+		r.state.UUID = id.String()
+		r.state.LastTimestamp = time.Time{}.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
+		needsSave = true
+	}
+	if _, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.state.LastTimestamp); err != nil {
+		r.state.LastTimestamp = time.Time{}.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
+		needsSave = true
+	}
+	if r.state.Version != schemaVersion {
+		needsSave = true
+	}
+	r.state.Version = schemaVersion
+	if needsSave {
+		if err := r.save(); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("writing telemetry state: %w", err)
+		}
+	}
+	return r, nil
+}
+
+// Start starts a background loop that reports at most once every four hours.
+func (r *Reporter) Start(ctx context.Context) {
+	go func() {
+		for {
+			r.mu.Lock()
+			last, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.state.LastTimestamp)
+			r.mu.Unlock()
+			wait := time.Until(last.Add(interval))
+			if wait > 0 {
+				timer := time.NewTimer(wait)
+				select {
+				case <-ctx.Done():
+					timer.Stop()
+					return
+				case <-timer.C:
+				}
+			}
+			if ctx.Err() != nil {
+				return
+			}
+			if err := r.Report(ctx); err != nil {
+				r.logger.Warnf("sending telemetry: %v", err)
+				// A failed send should not cause a tight retry loop.
+				select {
+				case <-ctx.Done():
+					return
+				case <-time.After(interval):
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}()
+}
+
+// Report sends one anonymous ping and records its successful delivery time.
+func (r *Reporter) Report(ctx context.Context) error {
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+
+	event := struct {
+		AnonymousId string `json:"anonymousId"`
+		Event       string `json:"event"`
+		Properties  struct {
+			UUID    string `json:"uuid"`
+			Version string `json:"version"`
+			Flipt   struct {
+				Version string `json:"version"`
+			} `json:"flipt"`
+		} `json:"properties"`
+	}{AnonymousId: r.state.UUID, Event: "flipt.ping"}
+	event.Properties.UUID = r.state.UUID
+	event.Properties.Version = schemaVersion
+	event.Properties.Flipt.Version = info.Version
+
+	data, err := json.Marshal(event)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("encoding telemetry event: %w", err)
+	}
+	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, r.endpoint, bytes.NewReader(data))
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("creating telemetry request: %w", err)
+	}
+	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+	resp, err := r.client.Do(req)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("sending telemetry request: %w", err)
+	}
+	defer resp.Body.Close()
+	_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body)
+	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("telemetry endpoint returned HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
+	}
+	previous := r.state.LastTimestamp
+	r.state.LastTimestamp = time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
+	if err := r.save(); err != nil {
+		r.state.LastTimestamp = previous
+		return fmt.Errorf("saving telemetry state: %w", err)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (r *Reporter) save() error {
+	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(r.state, "", "  ")
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(r.path), ".telemetry-*")
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	defer os.Remove(tmp.Name())
+	defer tmp.Close()
+	if err := tmp.Chmod(0600); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return os.Rename(tmp.Name(), r.path)
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,154 @@
+package telemetry
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gofrs/uuid"
+	"github.com/markphelps/flipt/config"
+	"github.com/markphelps/flipt/internal/info"
+	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestNewReporterDisabled(t *testing.T) {
+	dir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state")
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.TelemetryEnabled = false
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = dir
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Nil(t, r)
+	_, err = os.Stat(dir)
+	require.True(t, os.IsNotExist(err))
+}
+
+func TestNewReporterState(t *testing.T) {
+	dir := t.TempDir()
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = dir
+	path := filepath.Join(dir, "telemetry.json")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(`{"uuid":"broken","version":"old","lastTimestamp":"bad"}`), 0600))
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotNil(t, r)
+	first := readState(t, path)
+	_, err = uuid.FromString(first.UUID)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, schemaVersion, first.Version)
+	_, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, first.LastTimestamp)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	_, err = NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, first.UUID, readState(t, path).UUID)
+}
+
+func TestNewReporterFileAsDirectory(t *testing.T) {
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("x"), 0600))
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = path
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.Nil(t, r)
+}
+
+func TestNewReporterDefaultDirectory(t *testing.T) {
+	dir := t.TempDir()
+	t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", dir)
+	r, err := NewReporter(config.Default(), logrus.New())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotNil(t, r)
+	require.Equal(t, filepath.Join(dir, "telemetry.json"), r.path)
+}
+
+func TestReport(t *testing.T) {
+	dir := t.TempDir()
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = dir
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	path := filepath.Join(dir, "telemetry.json")
+	before := readState(t, path)
+
+	oldVersion := info.Version
+	info.Version = "1.2.3"
+	defer func() { info.Version = oldVersion }()
+
+	status := http.StatusServiceUnavailable
+	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
+		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, req.Method)
+		require.Equal(t, "application/json", req.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
+		var event struct {
+			AnonymousId string `json:"anonymousId"`
+			Event       string `json:"event"`
+			Properties  struct {
+				UUID    string `json:"uuid"`
+				Version string `json:"version"`
+				Flipt   struct {
+					Version string `json:"version"`
+				} `json:"flipt"`
+			} `json:"properties"`
+		}
+		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(req.Body).Decode(&event))
+		require.Equal(t, "flipt.ping", event.Event)
+		require.Equal(t, before.UUID, event.AnonymousId)
+		require.Equal(t, before.UUID, event.Properties.UUID)
+		require.Equal(t, schemaVersion, event.Properties.Version)
+		require.Equal(t, "1.2.3", event.Properties.Flipt.Version)
+		w.WriteHeader(status)
+	}))
+	defer server.Close()
+	r.endpoint = server.URL
+
+	require.Error(t, r.Report(context.Background()))
+	require.Equal(t, before.LastTimestamp, readState(t, path).LastTimestamp)
+	status = http.StatusAccepted
+	require.NoError(t, r.Report(context.Background()))
+	after := readState(t, path)
+	require.NotEqual(t, before.LastTimestamp, after.LastTimestamp)
+	_, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, after.LastTimestamp)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+}
+
+func TestStartReportsDuePing(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = t.TempDir()
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	sent := make(chan struct{}, 1)
+	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
+		sent <- struct{}{}
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusAccepted)
+	}))
+	defer server.Close()
+	r.endpoint = server.URL
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	defer cancel()
+	r.Start(ctx)
+	select {
+	case <-sent:
+	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
+		t.Fatal("due telemetry ping was not sent")
+	}
+	require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
+		return readState(t, filepath.Join(cfg.Meta.StateDirectory, "telemetry.json")).LastTimestamp != time.Time{}.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
+	}, 3*time.Second, 10*time.Millisecond)
+	cancel()
+}
+
+func readState(t *testing.T, path string) state {
+	t.Helper()
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	var s state
+	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &s))
+	return s
+}
